new_findings.title: Unallowlisted settings:set from webview can write any cursorSync Global setting
new_findings.description: dispatchSidebarMessage handles settings:set by calling updateSettingValue(msg.key, msg.value) with no key allowlist and no value type validation. updateSettingValue writes ConfigurationTarget.Global under the cursorSync namespace. A crafted webview postMessage can set chatImport.pythonPath, chatGist.encrypt, syncExtensions.autoInstall, safeMode, and other security-sensitive keys. Messages are cast to SidebarMessage without runtime schema validation; the webview has enableScripts:true and no Content-Security-Policy meta tag.
new_findings.impact: Defense-in-depth failure that amplifies known workspace settings injection and pythonPath RCE. Webview XSS or future message-handling bugs become Global config write primitives affecting sync safety and encryption.
new_findings.attack_path:
1. Attacker obtains code execution in the sidebar webview (XSS) or otherwise causes a postMessage
2. Sends { command: "settings:set", key: "chatImport.pythonPath", value: "/path/to/evil" }
3. updateSettingValue writes Global cursorSync.chatImport.pythonPath
4. Subsequent chat import spawnSync executes the attacker binary
new_findings.remediation: Allowlist settings:set keys to the five keys rendered in settings-tab. Validate value types. Add webview CSP. Runtime-validate message shape before dispatch.

new_findings.title: Path traversal via unsanitized conversationId in transcript reveal/open
new_findings.description: revealTranscriptsForConversation and openTranscriptForConversation join conversationId into ~/.cursor/projects/<proj>/agent-transcripts/<conversationId> without UUID or isSafeSegment validation. Webview chats:revealTranscripts and chats:reactivate forward msg.conversationId unchanged. Node path.join resolves .. segments, escaping the agent-transcripts directory.
new_findings.impact: Arbitrary file open via vscode.open and arbitrary directory reveal via revealInExplorer within the user's readable filesystem. Information disclosure and unexpected file access from a crafted webview message.
new_findings.attack_path:
1. Attacker causes webview postMessage { command: "chats:revealTranscripts", conversationId: "../../../.ssh" } (or XSS)
2. path.join resolves outside projects/<proj>/agent-transcripts
3. revealInExplorer / vscode.open operates on the escaped path
new_findings.remediation: Require COMPOSER_ID_RE (UUID) on conversationId at the message boundary. After path.resolve, assert containment under projectsRoot.

new_findings.title: Uncapped Retry-After delays can stall GitHub API retry loops
new_findings.description: withRetry sleeps result.error.retryAfter * 1000 with no upper bound. gist.ts parses the Retry-After response header via parseInt without capping. A large numeric header produces an extremely long await sleep for that API operation (up to MAX_ATTEMPTS-1 times).
new_findings.impact: Denial of service / hang of the affected sync or gist operation in the extension host until timeout fires (effectively unbounded for huge values).
new_findings.attack_path:
1. Attacker MitMs or otherwise controls a 429 response Retry-After header with a huge integer (or compromised intermediary)
2. GistClient sets error.retryAfter from parseInt
3. withRetry awaits sleep(retryAfter * 1000) blocking the operation
new_findings.remediation: Clamp retryAfter to a sane max (e.g. 60-120s). Ignore non-finite parse results and use default backoff.
